```yaml
name: Advanced Translation Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  translation-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install translate-toolkit msgfmt

      - name: Run gettext format string validation
        run: msgfmt -c -o /dev/null smooth_app/lib/l10n/messages.po

      - name: Run translate-toolkit quality checks
        run: pofilter smooth_app/lib/l10n/messages.po

      - name: Run custom translation checks
        run: python .github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py smooth_app/lib/l10n/messages.po

      - name: Upload results as artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: translation-check-results
          path: smooth_app/lib/l10n/results.txt

  notify-maintainers:
    needs: translation-check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()

    steps:
      - name: Download results artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: translation-check-results

      - name: Notify maintainers
        run: |
          echo "Translation check completed. Results can be found at: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow performs advanced translation checks for the `openfoodfacts/smooth-app` repository. It includes steps to validate gettext format strings, run industry-standard quality checks using `translate-toolkit`, and execute custom checks for specific translation rules. The results are uploaded as artifacts, and a notification step is included to alert maintainers about the completion of the checks.
